port_difficulty.why: Sixteen lines. It opens, reads one record and closes. The record is never used, and there is no AT END and no FILE STATUS. The only care is decoding a COMP-3 field it never touches, and there is no output to compare against.

blast_radius.why: Read-only and reversible, but it sits on the medium confidence contract edge with PGMW, and it produces no output. A wrong decode would be silent. A wrong file attribute would abend the read.

units.driving_fact: Reads SPARQ.TEST.MASTER through LAYOUTY while the writer uses LAYOUTX. The two copybooks are separate files with different field names.

port_difficulty.why: Tiny code, but it writes LAYOUT-REC with no MOVE or INITIALIZE, so the bytes it writes are undefined. The record has a COMP-3 field. The intended content and file length live in the JCL and the copybook, and there is no oracle.

blast_radius.why: Sole writer of the shared master. The reader uses a different copybook. A layout drift is silent, and the file is created and cataloged by the job.

units.driving_fact: Writes SPARQ.TEST.MASTER through LAYOUTX. The only reader, PGMR, reads it through LAYOUTY, so the contract edge is medium confidence.

port_difficulty.why: One step, one DD with DISP=SHR and a SYSOUT. No parameters, no utilities.

blast_radius.why: Read-only and reversible. If it runs before the writer has created the dataset it fails at allocation, which is loud. Its place in the nightly cycle is unknown because no scheduler was given.

units.driving_fact: Reads SPARQ.TEST.MASTER with DISP=SHR and no DCB, so the file attributes come from the catalog entry the writer job created.

port_difficulty.why: One step and one DD. The care is in the DD: a NEW,CATLG allocation with SPACE and a DCB that has to be reproduced or deliberately changed in the target.

blast_radius.why: Creates and catalogs the shared master. A rerun with the same name and DISP=NEW would fail at allocation, which is loud. The LRECL it sets decides the record length every reader sees, and a mismatch would be silent.

units.driving_fact: Allocates SPARQ.TEST.MASTER as NEW,CATLG,DELETE with RECFM=FB and LRECL=80, while the layout copybook describes a 15 byte record. The extractor does not read DCB.
